claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found. The capture keeps no page text, so a note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.

  'listed', (select count(*) from v),
  'on_run', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run),
  'record_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record),

  'both_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'already_after', count(*) filter (where r.checks = v.after_checks),
  'checked_now', count(*) filter (where r.checked),
  'confirm_matches', count(*) filter (where lv.verdict = 'confirm'
                                       and lv.requirements_fp = public.program_record_fp(r.record)))

    on r.college = v.college and r.control_number = v.control_number
  left join lateral (select pv.verdict, pv.requirements_fp from public.program_record_verdicts pv
                      where pv.college = v.college and pv.control_number = v.control_number
                      order by pv.id desc limit 1) lv on true;
